build_model_matrix_from_dataframe: build a model matrix from a pandas DataFrame using a patsy formula string
add_na_indicator_to_dataframe: add NA indicator columns to a DataFrame replacing nulls with default values
quantize_dataframe_columns: cut numeric columns of a DataFrame into quantile buckets with a specified number of bins
detect_high_cardinality_features: detect categorical columns with high cardinality in a DataFrame above a given threshold
drop_na_rows_from_dataframe: drop rows with missing values from a DataFrame and align corresponding weight series
